notes: CalibForge is overwhelmingly the best pool here and it is not close: its personal-assistant_* family is a purpose-built set of ICS-calendar and constrained-scheduling tasks, every one of them graded `strong` in verifier_strength.json, and eleven of them are defensible candidates for this single TB2.1 task. Six of my final ten come from there. Terminal-Lego is the surprise second: task_09097 is an explicit timetable CSP with 14 pinned assertions, and task_08960/task_09803 cover recurrence models, which nothing in the v1 pool did. The v1 pool has essentially no iCalendar content - `tools.py search all` for .ics|VEVENT|iCalendar returns exactly one hit across all 56,307 v1 rows (collective__icalendar-878). TMax has a large 'constraint satisfaction' family but most of those phrases are one bullet inside a sprawling multi-part DevOps task, so I down-weighted them and only took the ones where the constrained search is the actual deliverable. TerminalWorld and Recursive-Task-Synthesis have nothing in this area: TerminalWorld's ten are scheduling-adjacent configuration and solver-driving tasks that top out at overall 3, and RTS offers an N-Queens script and four copies of a chickens-and-cows Prolog puzzle. Both lists are filled to ten as instructed, and their low scores are the honest signal. See verifier_notes for two candidates the packet grades lower than verifier_strength.json does.
